hero.title: File:Battle of Leeds, 1643.png
hero.credit:
Own work

Approximate extent of Leeds as per File:Leeds map 1560.jpg and File:Leeds Map 1725.jpg
Battle details as per:
Cooke, David (2004). The Civil War in Yorkshire: Fairfax Versus Newcastle. Barnsley: Pen & Sword Military. ISBN 1-84415-076-3. Pages 39–41.
Markham, Clements R. (1870). The Life of the Great Lord Fairfax: Commander-in-Chief of the Army of the Parliament of England. London: Macmillan. OCLC 458125558. Pages 85–89.
hero.description: In January 1643, a Parliamentarian assault, led by Thomas Fairfax, captured Leeds. The map shows the approximate extent of Leeds at the time, and the avenues of attack taken by the Parliamentarians.
categories: Maps of battles of the English Civil War
